Founder · David Lopez

A bigger vision from the beginning.

What began with a 17-year-old working beside his father has grown into a complete landscape and hardscape company built around service, craft and the belief that life is better outdoors.

Our story · Since 2017

Built outside.
Built together.

Father Nature began in 2017 when David Lopez was 17. His practical education started years earlier, helping his father with local lawn work—mowing, trimming shrubs, planting flowers and learning the responsibility behind taking care of someone else’s property.

David initially pictured a career in anesthesiology. But he loved the outdoors, the work, and the opportunity to create something of his own. Advice from customers and mentors opened new doors, and every project added knowledge, capability and confidence.

That small landscaping company became a full-service landscape and hardscape team serving Bluffton, Hilton Head Island and surrounding communities. The vision remains personal: develop great people, deliver excellent work and help clients turn ideas into places where life happens.

Frequently asked questions

Good projects begin with clarity.

Answers to the questions property owners ask most often before beginning landscape and hardscape work.

Where does Father Nature work?

Father Nature serves Bluffton, Hilton Head Island, Okatie, Hardeeville and surrounding Lowcountry communities in South Carolina.

What services do you provide?

The team provides complete landscape and hardscape care: sod, maintenance, plants and palms, trees, irrigation, garden enrichments, commercial landscaping, pavers, turf, retaining walls, pathways, fire pits, night lighting, outdoor kitchens and power washing.

Are you licensed and insured?

Father Nature is presented as a fully licensed, bonded and insured professional company. Ask the team for the current documentation relevant to your project.

Can you provide same-day service?

Availability depends on the requested work, location, crew schedule and materials. Call the office and the team will confirm the earliest realistic visit.

Why hire a professional landscape company?

Professional planning protects safety, drainage, plant health, material performance and the overall investment while saving the owner significant time.

How is pricing determined?

Pricing reflects scope, site conditions, access, materials and labor. Father Nature offers complimentary consultations so the team can evaluate the property before preparing a proposal.

Does the team bring its own equipment?

Yes. Crews arrive with the professional equipment appropriate to the scheduled work and project conditions.

Do you serve commercial properties?

Yes. Father Nature works with commercial properties and can scope recurring maintenance, enhancements, irrigation, tree work and larger exterior improvements.

Do you guarantee the work?

The company stands behind its craftsmanship and focuses on customer satisfaction. Specific warranties and care requirements are reviewed with each proposal.
